14.18.title: Radar Transmitter-Receiver Isolation Requirement
14.18.title_cn: 雷达发射机-接收机隔离度要求计算
14.18.description: A pulse radar operates at 2 GHz and has a per-pulse power of 1 kW. If it is to be used to detect a target with $\sigma = 20 \text{ m}^2$ at a range of 10 km, what should be the minimum isolation between the transmitter and receiver so that the leakage signal from the transmitter is at least 10 dB below the received signal? Assume an antenna gain of 30 dB.
14.18.description_cn: 一部脉冲雷达工作频率为 2 GHz，每个脉冲的功率为 1 kW。若要用它探测距离 10 km 处、雷达散射截面 $\sigma = 20 \text{ m}^2$ 的目标，则发射机与接收机之间的最小隔离度应为多少，才能使发射机泄漏信号至少比接收信号低 10 dB？假设天线增益为 30 dB。

antenna_gain.description: Antenna gain (same for transmit and receive)

margin.description: Leakage must be at least 10 dB below received signal

steps.title: Received Power from Target (Monostatic Radar Equation)
steps.title_cn: 目标回波接收功率（单基地雷达方程）

steps.title: Maximum Allowable Leakage Power
steps.explanation: Leakage must be at least 10 dB below received signal
steps.explanation_cn: 泄漏信号至少比接收信号低 10 dB

steps.title: Minimum Isolation Required
steps.explanation: Isolation in dB is ratio of transmit power to leakage power
steps.explanation_cn: 隔离度（dB）为发射功率与泄漏功率之比

14.18.note: This isolation requirement is very high and typically achieved through a combination of circulator isolation, duplexer design, and possibly additional filtering and blanking techniques.
14.18.note_cn: 这一隔离度要求非常高，通常通过环行器隔离、双工器设计以及可能的附加滤波和消隐技术共同实现。
